needs-triage.description: Filed and waiting for the triage agent

triaged.description: Initial triage has been completed for this issue

agent:feature.description: Feature request, not a bug report

agent:priority-high.description: Regression, crash, data loss, or security report

area:cli.description: Argument parsing, command output, exit codes

repro:high.description: Highly reproducible from the available information

repro:low.description: Difficult to reproduce from the available information

repro:unknown.description: Not enough information to estimate reproducibility

needs-info.description: The reporter must answer follow-up questions before triage can finish

duplicate.description: Identified as a duplicate of two or more existing issues

ready-to-spec.description: Feature whose problem is understood and whose design is open for a spec

ready-to-implement.description: Ready for code: an actionable bug, or a feature whose design is settled

plan-approved.description: The specs on the branch are approved; implementation may start

reserved-internal.description: Reserved for maintainers; agents do no work on it

spec-in-review.description: Specs are written and waiting for the review agent

spec-changes-requested.description: The review agent rejected the specs

spec-reviewed.description: The review agent approved the specs; a maintainer decides next

in-review.description: Implementation is waiting for the review agent

changes-requested.description: The review agent rejected the implementation

agent-approved.description: The review agent approved; a maintainer gives the final review

needs-human.description: Agents are stuck; a maintainer must step in
